description: A 10-question context-modified version of the Force Concept Inventory created by John Stewart and colleagues to diagnose introductory mechanics students’ Newtonian-force concepts and misconceptions while reducing recognition and answer-recall effects.
title: FCIT (FCI transformed)

description: A multi-section measurement battery combining an adapted Family Capital Questionnaire, a nine-item Innovative Behavior Scale, and a standardized geography achievement scale for high-school students.
title: FCQ, Innovative Behavior Scale, and standardized geography achievement scale measurement battery
